// tau plugin wire contract.
//
// This file is the source of truth for the host<->plugin protocol. Both the
// tau host and every plugin binary compile against the Go code generated from
// it (pkg/plugin/api). Regenerate with `task proto`.
//
// Compatibility policy:
//   - Field, enum, and oneof numbers are append-only: never renumber or reuse
//     one. When removing a field, reserve its number and name.
//   - Evolve additively. Hosts skip unknown Widget/EventPayload kinds and
//     ignore unknown capability strings; plugins must tolerate absent fields
//     and Unimplemented host RPCs.
//   - A deliberate breaking change (package rename, field type change, enum
//     renumbering) must bump ProtocolVersion in api.Handshake so stale plugin
//     binaries are rejected at handshake instead of failing mid-call.

// Code generated by protoc-gen-go-grpc. DO NOT EDIT.
// versions:
// - protoc-gen-go-grpc v1.6.2
// - protoc             (unknown)
// source: tau/plugin/v1/extension.proto

package api

import (
	context "context"
	grpc "google.golang.org/grpc"
	codes "google.golang.org/grpc/codes"
	status "google.golang.org/grpc/status"
)
